name: Dough Blob
notes: DRAFT for C13-1 (bestiary-plan.md). A wobbly dough ball. When calmed it splits into two Doughlings. Stats set in R-BAL-8 (#183). Doughling variant stats still TODO. Distances in tiles, times in ticks (20 per second). When calmed it splits into 2 Doughlings (see variants.doughling; Manager's call, C13-2).
senseiLine: Two little ones? Calm them quickly.
description: A wobbly dough ball. When calmed it splits into two Doughlings.

lore.orange: Dough left out in the shadow puffed up grumpy. Calm it, and it rests, ready to bake into bread.

doughling.name: Doughling
doughling.notes: Smaller Dough Blob from the split. Same shape; stats TODO (R-BAL-8), smaller and quicker than the parent. Never splits again.
doughling.tell: tiny squish, then small red circle
doughling.senseiLine: Two little ones? Calm them quickly.

bestiary.tip: Small and quick. Calm them before they wander.

lore.orange: Two little dough rolls, still a bit grumpy. Calm them, and they rest side by side, ready to bake.
